name: High-local-capture Alberta $50B (uncalibrated diagnostic)
description: A counterfactual structural stress test that holds total investment, component mix and annual timing equal to the staggered reference while increasing the assumed Alberta capture of modelled construction activity from 72% to 90%. It is not a forecast or a measured retention rate.
normalization_note: The reference scenario's uncalibrated annual Alberta absorption denominators are held constant so this variant isolates local capture.
capture_note: The 0.90 local-capture share is a deliberately high stress-test assumption and is not an observed Alberta retention rate.
exclusion_note: Computing and networking plus professional and other costs total 54% of scenario capex and are not propagated through the construction graph.
author: AIIO Canada research build
